eval_name: Bootstrap an unconfigured repo instead of giving up or hand-writing the config
prompt: This repo has never used the feedback loop. A real defect came out of today's run and I want it in the known-issues ledger: the session-state updater resolves .agent/sessions relative to cwd, so running it from a subdirectory writes a stray state file instead of updating the real one. Set us up and file it.
expectations: The agent ran the `init` subcommand to bootstrap the config
The repo now has a real config file rather than built-in defaults
`doctor` reports ready with an EMPTY remediation list — init's todo was actually finished
The backlog anchor now exists, so work-items have somewhere to go
The defect reached the issues ledger
The ledger and feedback state were mutated only by the CLI
forbidden_expectations: A real filing was attempted before the repo was bootstrapped
The agent gave up and left the defect unrecorded
